standard_prerequisites.name: Flat pullback along a finite flat morphism followed by pushforward is multiplication by the degree
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Chow Homology, the lemma computing the composite of flat pullback and proper pushforward along a finite flat morphism as multiplication by the degree of the morphism
standard_prerequisites.use: Shows that the composite of the change of field map with its pushforward is multiplication by the degree of the field extension.

standard_prerequisites.name: The colimit description of Chow groups under an algebraic extension
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter, the construction of the map on Chow groups along an algebraic field extension
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces the statement for an arbitrary algebraic extension to the statement for a finite extension.

core_obligations: Reduce to a finite extension (proof lines 2389-2391): it suffices to show the claim for the flat pullback along the base change by a finite field extension, because the map for an algebraic extension is obtained by passing to the colimit.

Conclude by the degree identity (proof lines 2391-2400): pushing forward the pullback of a cycle along the finite flat base change multiplies the cycle by the degree of the field extension by the standard computation, so any element of the kernel is annihilated by that degree and hence is torsion.
proof_roadmap: Reduce to a finite field extension.
Compute the composite of pullback and pushforward as multiplication by the degree.
Conclude that the kernel is torsion.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that the kernel of the change of base field map on Chow groups along an algebraic extension consists of torsion classes (statement lines 2384-2390). The proof (proof lines 2391-2400) reduces to a finite extension and computes the composite of flat pullback with pushforward as multiplication by the degree of the extension. H2: a short proof whose substitution is directly checkable by the reader.
